purpose: Close the missing restricted composition seam from a pre-cap ponded O14 committed state through the 1 cm surface-cap event into the already-qualified Ross post-cap runoff continuation. Candidate and independent reference must each solve one constrained cap-event corrector from the same committed state and then continue for exactly 1 day after cap onset with explicit runoff ownership.

event_corrector_policy.candidate: one constrained nonlinear solve of [h0,h1,h2,tau] using the qualified 5 cm candidate surface face plus qualified candidate internal faces; A4 representative cap root is warm-start only
event_corrector_policy.reference: one constrained nonlinear solve of [h0,h1,h2,tau] using independent high-accuracy surface and internal face references; same A4 seed

post_cap_policy.candidate: exact A7-R1 instrumentation-separated Ross continuation policy
post_cap_policy.reference: exact A6-R1 independent reference continuation policy

whole_path_mass_identity: Delta_S_soil_total + (S_cap-S0) + Q_runoff_postcap + Q_bottom_precap + Q_bottom_postcap - q_supply*(tau_cap+1 day) = 0
hard_guards: Do not change A4 profile states, A4 seed roots, 1 cm cap, 12*KSAT supply, -15 cm bottom head, event bounds or A7 40x0.025 d continuation after execution.
A4 seeds are qualification fixtures only; PASS does not qualify automatic event detection or bracket discovery.
Do not force top-node h=0. A4/A5/A6 established that cap onset precedes top saturation and the post-cap attractor remains unsaturated in this topology.
Do not publish event scratch state before all event mass, route and reference checks pass.
Do not carry pre-cap qtop across the cap event; post-cap qtop must be recomputed from the committed cap state.
Do not clip surface water at 1 cm; all post-cap surplus must enter the explicit runoff ledger.
Do not add other materials, caps, forcing, bottom boundaries, response tangents, runtime, MultiSWAP or groundwater to A8.

architecture_checks.3_data_separation: forcing, committed state, event scratch, runoff result ledger and diagnostics remain separate
architecture_checks.4_compact_state: no event-time or duplicate cap-state persistence
architecture_checks.5_worker_scratch: event and step nonlinear vectors are worker-local
architecture_checks.7_transactionality: pre-cap committed state remains immutable until accepted cap event; synthetic event rejection rolls back all state and ledger changes
architecture_checks.8_warm_start: A4 cap roots may seed the corrector but event equations originate from the true pre-cap committed state
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: tau is a generic offset inside [t0,t1]; post-cap continuation uses explicit intervals without calendar assumptions
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation: hard 1e-9 cm event and whole-path balances; no repair/clipping
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: one event corrector plus one fixed post-cap candidate trajectory; no repeated full-trajectory event search
architecture_checks.25_reference_mode: independent event and continuation references remain qualification-only
architecture_checks.28_runtime_composition: surface cap and runoff remain outside the soil-face kernel

hard_nonclaims: No automatic event detection or bracket discovery.
No surface caps other than 1 cm and no material other than O14.
No response tangent through cap onset or runoff continuation.
No production implementation, runtime, MultiSWAP, MODFLOW or groundwater admission.
